entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: CADC serves CFHT data and answered anonymously on 2026-09-17 through its TAP service (argus, sync and async endpoints). Public files need no credentials; proprietary access is granted by CADC group membership per run.
entries.revisitWhen: A body or star in this repository needs CFHT data.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: The proprietary period is typically 13 months after the end of the semester. No reuse licence is published; CADC asks for its own acknowledgement sentence and directs users to CFHT's acknowledgement page.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed for a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: CFHT detrends with Elixir and CADC stacks with MegaPipe. Both run as services rather than distributed packages: no download or licence is published, and users are asked to cite the MegaPipe paper.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.

entries.subject: What this archive holds for catalogued bodies
entries.finding: The same screen matched 118 bodies across CADC's Gemini and CFHT collections, 59,021 rows, largest instruments NIRI (37543), GNIRS (6171), ESPaDOnS (5604). The counts are archive-wide, not per telescope.
entries.revisitWhen: A Gemini or CFHT candidate from the screen is taken up.
